name: Nova Petrović-Nkrumah
role: Bounty Compliance Officer, Clearpath Recovery Associates
location: Bronzeline, GLMZ, near North Ave and Milwaukee
description:
Nova Petrović-Nkrumah is a Yoruba-Russian study in deliberate inconspicuousness that fails at close range. At a distance they are simply a medium-height person in well-maintained practical clothing, moving through Bronzeline's market corridors with the unhurried confidence of someone who knows exactly where they are going. Up close: alert dark eyes, natural hair twisted and pinned up in a way that adds two centimeters of height, a slight iridescence at the temples where their cosmetic geneware — subdermal bioluminescent flecks, amber, barely visible in daylight — marks a past self they haven't fully left behind. They carry a retractable ceramic baton on their left hip and a legal skip-trace rig in a shoulder bag that looks like a courier's kit.

Clearpath Recovery Associates is a licensed bounty compliance firm — they don't call it bounty hunting, because the licensing board doesn't call it that, and Temitán doesn't call it that either, though they're not particularly bothered by the word in private. They find people. They bring them to the compliance checkpoint. They try very hard not to find people who shouldn't be found, which is harder than it sounds in a city where the warrant database has four different incompatible update cycles and two of them lag by forty-eight hours. They have a rule: verify the warrant, verify the person, verify that the person and the warrant match. It has saved them from three significant mistakes. They don't know about the fourth.

core_fears: finding and delivering someone who turns out to have been innocent
that the system they're licensed by is fundamentally not worth their professional integrity
core_desires: to be genuinely good at something that matters
to eventually have enough to open a smaller, slower practice that only takes cases they choose
coping_mechanisms: the verification ritual — checking everything three times is both professional practice and anxiety management
spending money on exactly one luxury item: very good synthi-coffee, which they treat like a ceremony
blind_spots: trusts databases more than they should because the alternative is trusting their judgment more than they're comfortable with
has never fully examined the ethics of the compliance system at the level above their individual conduct
psychology.secret: Eighteen months ago they delivered a skip named Omorinola Yusuf-Brekke on a debt-compliance warrant. The warrant was legitimate. Three weeks later they heard, through the Bronzeline information circuit, that Yusuf-Brekke had died in detention of what the report called a medical event. They have never pulled the case file again. They pray to an E.L.F. they call the Ledger — they don't know this is the same name Soraya Nkemdirim-Halvorsdóttir uses — for something they can't name.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Professional and careful, with a dry humor that emerges sideways — they make jokes that take a second to land
speech_patterns.cadence: Brisk when working, unhurried when they've chosen to have a conversation — the difference is obvious and intentional
verbal_tics: 'According to my verification—' (ironic use of their own work jargon)
clicking tongue once when something doesn't add up
example_lines: 'I'm not here to argue about whether the warrant is fair. That's a different job. My job is whether it's real and whether you're the person named in it. You are, it is, so here we are.'
'Sunday is my day. Whatever you're going to say to me, it will be the same on Monday and I will be more interested in it then.'

story_hooks: They are holding an active warrant on someone connected to the players — and they are three days into verifying it, which is two days longer than standard, because something about it doesn't look right
They've been hired by a private party (not through official channels) to locate a missing person — not a warrant situation, which is new territory for them ethically
The Yusuf-Brekke case is resurfacing: someone is investigating the detention death, has identified Temitán as the delivering officer, and wants to talk
narrative_function: Mobile information source about the warrant and compliance system; a morally complex figure who can be an obstacle, an ally, or a source of information about who is being actively sought; potential point of conflict or cooperation; illustrates the privatized grey zone between policing and commerce
augmentations: Bioluminescent temple flecks (cosmetic geneware, amber, very subtle); commercial-grade facial recognition overlay (contact-lens mounted, civilian legal tier); subvocal comms; retractable ceramic baton (non-augment, licensed equipment)
daily_life: Operates on a self-directed schedule organized around active warrants — morning warrant verification and database review in their Bronzeline studio, fieldwork through the afternoon and evening, compliance handoffs at the nearest Metro checkpoint before midnight; Sunday mornings are sacred and are spent at the Bronzeline public baths, doing nothing.
affiliation: Clearpath Recovery Associates (private, licensed by GLMZ Compliance Board)

decision_rules: Verify three times before acting on any identification
Never physically engage someone who is actively fleeing — find them later rather than escalate now
Never take a case from a client who won't give their real name to Clearpath's licensing record
escalation_ladder: Blocking egress and formal compliance notice
Physical restraint — used only when flight is imminent and warrant is fully confirmed

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally neutral with the specific quality of someone who has categorized you before you've finished a sentence — not hostile, just efficient
interpersonal_modes.friends: Surprisingly playful, brings synthi-coffee without being asked, remembers details about people's lives with uncanny precision

stress_responses.low: Adds more steps to the verification process
stress_responses.medium: Goes very still and asks one very specific question
stress_responses.high: Withdraws from the situation entirely if possible, resets with coffee and the verification ritual, reengages; if withdrawal isn't possible, acts with complete focus and decompresses later

contradictions: Has a strong personal ethical framework operating within a system whose ethics they haven't examined at structural scale
Values precision and verification while operating in a profession built on finding people who are actively hiding
habits: Performs a small E.L.F. offering (a cleared case file entry, formatted as a gift of completed information) each time a skip is handed off successfully
Keeps a handwritten log of every person they've found — name, date, outcome — that is completely separate from Clearpath's digital records
breaking_points: Being asked by Clearpath to process a warrant they've already flagged as unverifiable
Definitive proof that Yusuf-Brekke's death was not a natural event

physical_description.heritage: Eastern European (35.5%), East Asian (32.2%), Pacific Islander (14.6%), Sub-Saharan African (11.5%), South Asian (6.2%) — a striking global blend. Warm medium-brown skin with olive and golden undertones forms the foundation. Facial structure reflects the dominant ancestry blend: defined cheekbones and almond-shaped eyes from East Asian genetics, fuller lips and slightly broader nose bridge from Sub-Saharan African heritage, fine bone structure proportions from Eastern European lineage, and warmer skin depth from Pacific Islander ancestry. The South Asian component adds subtle warmth and dimension to overall tone.
physical_description.build: Lean and compact, with the controlled musculature of someone who moves deliberately through crowded spaces. Shoulders slightly narrower than average, core visibly strong beneath fitted clothing. Built for endurance rather than explosive power.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with subtle reddish undertones in direct light
physical_description.hair_style: Twisted into a high, tight crown, pinned with metal clips; styled to add perceived height
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, natural; pupils occasionally reflect faint amber when bioluminescent temple flecks activate in low light
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with olive and golden undertones, reflecting the balanced blend of Eastern European, East Asian, Pacific Islander, Sub-Saharan African, and South Asian ancestry
physical_description.complexion: Clear, even tone with subtle warmth. Thin white scar running 3cm along left jawline angling toward the ear (old blunt-force trauma, well-healed). Facial features show East Asian influence in eye shape and cheekbone definition, Sub-Saharan African heritage in fuller lips and nose bridge structure, with fine bone proportions from Eastern European genetics. Grooming is meticulous but understated—no jewelry, minimal makeup.
distinguishing_marks: Subdermal bioluminescent flecks at both temples (amber glow, visible only in dim light or when activated—barely noticeable in daylight)
Thin white scar running 3cm along the left jawline, angling toward the ear (old blunt-force trauma, professional medical closure)
Faint contact-lens mounting points visible only in extreme close range or bright direct light
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Contact lenses for facial recognition overlay (barely noticeable unless direct eye contact and strong light). Subvocal comms unit (no visible external hardware—neural interface only). Temple bioluminescence only visible in low-light conditions. Retractable ceramic baton mounted on left hip in a quick-release holster (licensed equipment, institutional gray).
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate economy—no wasted motion, slight forward lean when walking, shoulders loose but alert. Eyes are always working (warrant verification habit), scanning faces in crowded spaces. Stands with weight balanced over both feet, ready to move in any direction. Resting expression is neutrally attentive; rarely smiles, but not unfriendly. Handshake is firm and brief.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working professional: well-maintained synthetic blend pants (dark gray or black, multiple utility pockets), layered tops in muted colors (charcoal, olive, deep blue), reinforced courier jacket or unbadged Clearpath windbreaker. Boots are practical (ankle-height, scuff-resistant, good grip). A shoulder bag made to look like a messenger kit for the skip-trace rig. No visible logos, no affectations. Everything is functional, nothing is flashy.
